utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Monday the 26th. Can you hear me all right? Teams is showing half of you as little grey circles.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, got you. Anyone actually get their weekend plans done? We were going walking, then the weather did that sideways-rain thing.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: I got as far as opening the back door. That was enough outdoors.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Sensible. Oh, and the charity bake sale on Friday — apparently there was proper competition over the lemon cake. More tension than a shutdown meeting.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Cake's no use without coffee. That broken coffee machine in the canteen's still just an expensive flashing light. Not putting it on this meeting, before anyone says it.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Good, because I haven't got a planning code for emotional damage.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before we disappear down that hole. Finished stuff first, then what actually needs agreeing.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah so, I signed off the inspection on the Line 1 Hydraulic Power Unit on Tuesday. That's closed, not something outstanding.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: And I signed off the inspection on the line 1 mould temp on Tuesday as well. Both done.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cheers. I tested the line three yesterday and it's all fine now. Nothing new coming out of that.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Only an observation from me: saw the pressure on the newer turbine dip for a few minutes, it came back on its own.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Back where it was, yeah? Not still sitting low?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, back where it was. Just saying what I saw, not raising a job for today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay. Olu, can you inspect the big valve by the gate for leaks, tomorrow at 9:30? It's urgent.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Sorry, I can't take that one. I'm not available for that slot, so don't put it against me.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, Doyler, can I hand that to you instead? Inspect the big valve by the gate for leaks, tomorrow at 9:30. It's urgent.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take it. The big valve by the gate, leaks, tomorrow at 9:30.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Doyler. That's yours rather than Olu's, then.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: While we're on going out and about, I'll do a site visit at the treatment plant with the contractor today at 2pm.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cheers, Haley. Today at 2pm with the contractor, agreed.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yep. That's the visit I'm taking.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Your sound went a bit underwater there, but I got two o'clock.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Um, I'll order spare parts for the Injection Moulding Line 3 tomorrow morning as well. It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, Fi, spare parts for the Injection Moulding Line 3, tomorrow morning. Not in the urgent pile.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Exactly. And those aren't the parts holding up the other job, just so we don't muddle them.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Still waiting on parts for the heater box on one, nothing we can do until they arrive. The repair's blocked; I'm not promising that for today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood, repair stays blocked. Separate from the repair, Fi, can you do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the heater box on one today? It's urgent.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: No, sorry, I can't take that sign-off. You'll need to hand that one to someone else.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Ash, can you take it instead? Do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the heater box on one today — it's urgent.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the heater box on one today. Understood on the urgency.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks. To be clear, that's the isolation sign-off, not declaring the repair finished or releasing it to run.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Absolutely. Parts blocker hasn't magically gone away.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah so, I'll run a function test on the line 1 TCU this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Callum Reid. That's an 'if you've got a spare minute' one, not an urgent job.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yep, low priority understood. I'll do the line 1 TCU function test this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: And that's separate from those inspections I said were closed. Just in case my sound chopped the names up.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, separate. Not reopening either of yours.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Also, I'll send the shift handover report round by the 28th.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cheers, Cal. Same sort of priority on that — if you've got a spare minute.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Fine, not a rush job, but by the 28th. Got it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Olu, can you sort the training records for the new starters by the end of the week? Again, if you've got a spare minute.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll sort the training records for the new starters by the end of the week. I can take that, just couldn't take the valve slot.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, understood. Different sort of commitment.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Exactly. Records don't generally require me to stand outside in horizontal rain.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Before we move off the people bits, I'll organise the toolbox talk for the team by the 28th. That's fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Aisha. Toolbox talk organised by the 28th, fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yep, I'll take that.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Sorry, did you say—

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: The 28th. Sorry, talked over you.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: No, that's what I missed. My headset did a little robot impression.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: There's also the monthly fire alarm test. Someone needs to run the monthly fire alarm test by 11am. It matters but it's not urgent. Anyone taking that?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Not volunteering there, sorry. I don't want a silence to get read as me saying yes.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Same here, I haven't taken that one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. No takers, then. The monthly fire alarm test is still needed by 11am, but nobody owns it. I'm not putting a name against it.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, don't roll that into mine either. Mine's just the site visit at the treatment plant with the contractor today at 2pm.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood, Haley. No extras attached.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: And I've got the urgent leak inspection tomorrow at 9:30, plus the spare parts order tomorrow morning, which isn't urgent. Those two are clear.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Same here — urgent lock-out tag-out sign-off today, and organising the toolbox talk by the 28th. No claim that the blocked repair is done.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Training records by the end of the week is clear for me.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. And the fire alarm test remains unclaimed, not quietly agreed by the group.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Right. Back to the flashing coffee monument, then.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Enjoy the light show. Thanks, everyone, that's us.
